homeAboutDesc: Established in 2022 in Montreal, Ivoire is a pioneering Canadian company dedicated to producing high-quality tissue paper using sustainable bamboo resources. By merging African entrepreneurial heritage with Canadian technological excellence, we offer eco-friendly alternatives to traditional paper products.
homeBambooPowerDesc: Bamboo is the largest species of grass, offering unparalleled environmental benefits.
homeBambooPower1: Grows up to 3 feet a day.
homeBambooPower3: Uses less land due to density.
homeBambooPower6: Absorbs 12 tonnes of CO2 per year.

homeOemPoint2: A variety of embossing for you to choose or custom development.
homeOemPoint3: Custom packaging based on your design and method.
